definitions.gloss: premature; too early; the time is not yet ripe
definitions.explanation: Said of an action, decision, or judgment that would come before conditions are ready. A four-character compound common in formal speech and writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時期尚早|じきしょうそう}だ。
examples.english: It's too early to draw a conclusion.

examples.japanese: {時期尚早|じきしょうそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Some objected that it was premature.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{治療法|ちりょうほう}→治療法：27941_chiryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時期尚早|じきしょうそう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Because the data are still insufficient, introducing the new treatment is considered premature.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (time, timing) + ⟦{尚早|しょうそう}→尚早：28068_shousou⟧ (still too early).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時期尚早|じきしょうそう}だ (it is premature to ~)
- {時期尚早|じきしょうそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ / ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (the view that it is premature)
- {時期尚早|じきしょうそう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧ (to shelve something as premature)

REGISTER:
Formal; at home in meetings, editorials, and official statements. In casual speech: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧.
